acceptance: A PASS cycle whose committed id matches a carryover entry removes it; a FAIL on a triage-less continuation increments a durable failure_count visible to the quarantine check; 124-entry generic flood collapses to <=1 entry per fingerprint.
Router window regains memo/product slots: a fixture with 20 generic P0s + 1 memo carryover surfaces the memo entry post-dedupe.
fix: (a) On PASS with a committed carryover id, delete the matching state entry (anchor: inboxmover/outcome.go PASS path + a state hook beside mergeCarryoverTodos); (b) fingerprint-dedupe the per-FAIL generic P0 records; (c) key FAIL accounting to the continuation-registry scope id when triage-decision.json is absent (escalationScopeIDs in retry_tier_escalation.go:76-92 already resolves it; wire at the closeout seam cycleoutcome.go:88), mirroring the count into the durable item so quarantine/escalation see repeated failure.
problem: (1) carryoverTodos is a write-only log: 254 entries, no removal-on-pick/ship path (TTL-only drain, failurelog/prune_carryover.go:23); 124 are near-identical generic 'cycle N failed' P0s (failure_learning.go:315/:786) that saturate the 20-slot router window (phase_advisor.go:809,856), permanently shadowing memo/product carryovers. (2) All 81 inbox items sit at failure_count:0 after 15 FAILs because ApplyCycleOutcome bumps only triage-decision top_n ids resolvable as inbox FILES (inboxmover/outcome.go:100-118) while continuation retries mint new slugs and skip triage — so TaskRetryCeiling=2 quarantine, BuildDeepEscalateAtFailures, and split pressure NEVER fire.
resolution: PARTIALLY RESOLVED 2026-08-11: PR #439 landed parts (b) fingerprint dedupe (+TTL-refresh-on-suppress) and (c) lane-scope failure-identity fallback (file-absent trigger). Part (a) retirement-on-PASS re-filed smaller as carryover-pass-retirement (0.72).
title: carryoverTodos retirement path + P0 flood dedupe + stable failure_count identity (three dead governors, one root)
